# TEST-FIXTURE-ONLY Component B Item Catalogue

This file is a minimal, non-authoritative catalogue used only by BE3b/BE3c adapter, privacy, and
characterization tests. It is **not** the governed R26-IT-138 catalogue and must never be
referenced by a production runtime bundle. It covers all 36 template ids from
`backend/provenance/component-b-coverage.json` (29 implemented + 7 deferred) across the seven
frozen skills, so the full implemented/deferred partition and both grade gates can be exercised
deterministically without touching the real catalogue file. Each implemented template's
`grade_scope` is set to reproduce the exact `eligible_grades` declared by its sampler in the
vendored `component_b_generator.samplers` registry (BE3.2/BE3c); the seven deferred templates are
marked `DEFERRED_*` so `is_active()` is false regardless of grade, matching their coverage-report
decision codes.
